meta.note: Three layers: primitives (brand-*, green-*, forest-*, neutral-*, amber/red/blue-*), semantic (bg-*, surface-*, text-*, border-*, primary, accent, success, warning, destructive, info, focus-*), component (sidebar-*, button-*, input-*, card-*, table-*, progress-*, tooltip-*, ai-*, avatar-*). Components consume semantic or component tokens only.

tokens.name: brand-smoky-black
tokens.usage: Palette 01 · Smoky Black (RGB 16,18,17). Primitive. Use through text-primary, never directly in components.

tokens.name: brand-green
tokens.usage: Palette 02 · Green (RGB 86,187,123). Primitive brand accent. 2.39:1 on white — NEVER put white text on it and never use it as text on light grounds. Pair with smoky-black text (7.87:1).

tokens.name: brand-dark-green
tokens.usage: Palette 03 · Dark Green (RGB 33,72,62). Primitive. Sidebar, primary buttons, focus ring. White text on it: 10.19:1.

tokens.name: brand-near-black
tokens.usage: Palette 04 · Near Black (RGB 27,27,27). Primitive. Tooltip and toast grounds.

tokens.name: brand-grey-green
tokens.usage: Palette 05 · Grey Green (RGB 165,173,168). Primitive. Decorative dividers and disabled text only — 2.30:1 on white, not for readable text.

tokens.name: brand-soft-white
tokens.usage: Palette 06 · White (RGB 247,247,247). Primitive. The workspace canvas.

spacing.note: 4px base, 8px rhythm. Prefer even steps; space-1 and space-3 for tight icon/text gaps only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap in badges; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and nav; label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside compact rows; gap between badge groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter; card padding on mobile; gap between form fields on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between form fields on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter; gap between page sections.

radius.note: Restrained: 8px for controls, 12px for cards. Pills only for badges, switches and avatars.

tokens.usage: Checkbox, tooltip, inline code, progress bar.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, menu items, nav items, tags.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheet top corners, the app frame on large screens.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Badges, switch track, avatars, radio dot. Nowhere else.
